props.headline: The Man Who Can't See the Board
props.subhead: Ryan Searle has a degenerative eye condition. He can't see past six feet. The dartboard is nearly eight feet away. He's in his first World Championship semi-final.

props.label: The Condition
props.title: Dominant Optic Atrophy
props.body: Searle functional sight barely extends beyond six feet — the oche is 7ft 9in from the board. He [[relies on the crowd's reaction]] to know his score.

props.quote: Really not bothered. You guys pay for tickets and you pay for my prize so thanks for booing me. Thank you for my money!
props.author: Luke Littler

props.label: Searle's Path to Semi-Final
props.subtitle: Sets dropped: just 2 in 5 matches. Whitewashed 3 opponents.

props.label: The Villain Arc
props.title: Littler Embraces the Heel
props.body: The 17-year-old defending champion has faced hostile crowds all tournament. Rather than shrink, he's [[embraced a heel persona]] reminiscent of Phil Taylor — finding a higher level when the audience turns against him.

props.label: Ryan Searle
props.subtitle: First World Championship semi-final. Career-best run at age 36.
